# scc_feature_configuration (Data Source)

Look up an existing FeatureConfiguration object. Set identity or name to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.
- `name` (String) Maps to the -Name parameter.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Maps to the -Comment parameter.
- `feature_scenario` (String) Maps to the -FeatureScenario parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `locations` (String) Maps to the -Locations parameter.
- `mode` (String) Maps to the -Mode parameter.
- `policy_rbac_scopes` (String) Maps to the -PolicyRBACScopes parameter.
- `scenario_config` (String) Maps to the -ScenarioConfig parameter.
